name: Answer Engine Optimizer (AEO)
author: Troon Technologies

sections.description:
Answer Engine Optimizer (AEO) is the ultimate WordPress plugin for optimizing your content to appear in AI-generated answers from platforms like Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity, and other AI search engines.

While traditional SEO focuses on ranking in search results, AEO ensures your content is selected and featured directly in AI-generated answers—the future of how users discover information.

Core Features

Real-Time AEO Scoring
* Unified AEO score (0-100) with detailed component breakdown
* Yoast SEO-style scoring interface with color-coded indicators
* Real-time updates as you edit content in Gutenberg
* Instant feedback on content quality and optimization

Smart Summary Management
* Manual summary editor with character counter (optimal: 300-500 chars)
* Auto-generated summaries from content blocks
* AI-powered summary suggestions via OpenAI integration
* Summary type indicator (Manual/Auto)

Structured Data & Schema
* Automatic JSON-LD schema generation
* Article schema with AEO summary integration
* FAQ schema for question/answer content
* Service schema for local businesses
* Proper schema markup for AI crawler understanding

Content Analysis & Guidance
* Content Structuring recommendations
* FAQ items detection and optimization
* Service metadata validation (for service post type)
* Real-time improvement tips with severity levels
* AI Crawler Visibility checks

Comprehensive Dashboard
* Content audit report with PDF export
* Post-type filtering and score-based filtering
* Statistics cards (Excellent, Needs Improvement, Poor)
* Average score tracking
* Content coverage by post type

REST API & Extensibility
* REST API endpoints for programmatic access
* /wp-json/aeo/v1/analyze/{post_id} – Unified analysis
* /wp-json/aeo/v1/score/{post_id} – Score only
* /wp-json/aeo/v1/tips/{post_id} – Improvement tips
* /wp-json/aeo/v1/visibility/{post_id} – Visibility checks
* Rate limiting and caching built-in
* Subscription-ready filter hooks

Performance Optimized
* Debounced real-time updates (1.5s delay)
* 5-second server-side caching
* 2-second client-side caching
* Optimized for large content (5000+ words)
* Graceful fallback for Classic Editor

Why Answer Engine Optimization?

Traditional SEO focuses on ranking in search results. AEO ensures your content is selected by AI systems to generate direct answers to user queries. As AI-powered search becomes mainstream, AEO is essential for content visibility.

Perfect For

  • Content marketers optimizing for AI discovery
  • SEO professionals expanding into AEO
  • Business owners wanting AI visibility
  • Bloggers and publishers
  • Local businesses with service offerings
  • E-commerce sites with product content
  • News and publishing platforms

Additional Information

Plugin Support

For support, documentation, and updates, visit:
* Website: https://troontechnologies.com
* Documentation: https://troontechnologies.com/aeo-docs
* Support Forum: https://wordpress.org/support/plugin/aeo-ranking/

Compatibility

  • ✅ WordPress 6.0+
  • ✅ PHP 7.4+
  • ✅ Gutenberg Block Editor
  • ✅ Classic Editor
  • ✅ Multisite compatible
  • ✅ Compatible with major SEO plugins

Performance

  • Real-time updates with 1.5s debounce
  • 5-second server-side caching
  • 2-second client-side caching
  • Optimized for content up to 10,000+ words
  • Minimal database queries

Security

  • Nonce verification on all AJAX requests
  • Capability checks (manage_options for settings)
  • Edit post capability for content analysis
  • Sanitized and escaped output
  • No external data storage

Third Party Services

This plugin may connect to external third-party services to provide AI-powered features. All connections are optional and require explicit user configuration and consent.

OpenAI API Integration

Service: OpenAI API (https://api.openai.com/)
Purpose: Generate AI-powered content summaries and suggestions
Data Sent: Post title, post content, and user-provided prompts
When Data is Sent: Only when you manually click “Get AI Suggestions” or “Generate Summary” buttons in the post editor
User Consent Required: Yes – requires manual API key configuration in plugin settings
Privacy Policy: https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy
Terms of Service: https://openai.com/policies/terms-of-use

Important Privacy Information

  • No Automatic Data Transmission: The plugin does not send any data to external services automatically
  • Manual Action Required: All API calls require explicit user action (clicking a button)
  • API Key Required: You must manually configure an OpenAI API key in Settings before any external connections are made
  • No Data Storage: This plugin does not store any data on external servers
  • Local Processing: All content analysis, scoring, and schema generation happens locally on your WordPress server
  • Optional Feature: AI-powered features are completely optional – the plugin works fully without external API connections

Data Handling

When you use AI-powered features:
1. You click “Get AI Suggestions” or similar button
2. The plugin sends your post title and content to OpenAI API
3. OpenAI processes the request and returns suggestions
4. The suggestions are displayed in your WordPress admin
5. No data is permanently stored by OpenAI (subject to their data retention policies)

User Control

  • You control when data is sent (manual button clicks only)
  • You can use the plugin without configuring any external APIs
  • You can remove your API key at any time to disable external connections
  • All AI features clearly indicate when they will connect to external services

Additional Information

For questions about how OpenAI handles your data, please review:
* OpenAI Privacy Policy: https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy
* OpenAI API Data Usage: https://openai.com/policies/api-data-usage-policies

Trademark Notice

ChatGPT is a trademark of OpenAI. Perplexity is a trademark of Perplexity AI, Inc. Google AI is a trademark of Google LLC. OpenAI is a trademark of OpenAI.

This plugin is an independent tool designed to help optimize content for AI-powered search and answer engines. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by OpenAI, Perplexity AI, Google, or any other mentioned companies.

All product names, logos, brands, and trademarks mentioned in this plugin are the property of their respective owners. Use of these names does not imply any affiliation with or endorsement by the trademark holders.

Roadmap

  • Phase 2: Advanced REST API with subscription gating
  • Phase 3: Web Worker support for large content
  • Advanced AI features with custom prompts
  • Bulk optimization tools
  • Integration with popular page builders

Clean, professional design featuring the Answer Engine Optimizer branding with AI-themed elements. Blue and purple gradient background with modern typography.

Minimalist icon representing AI optimization with a search/magnifying glass combined with AI elements. Professional, clean design suitable for WordPress.org repository.

* Accent: #96C6EA to #B597F6 (Gradient)

* Error: #d63638 (Red)
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin:

    • Download the plugin files
    • Upload to /wp-content/plugins/aeo-ranking/ directory
    • OR install directly through WordPress Plugins → Add New

  2. Activate the plugin:

    • Go to Plugins menu in WordPress admin
    • Find “Answer Engine Optimizer (AEO)”
    • Click “Activate”

  3. Configure API (Optional but recommended):

    • Go to Answer Engine Optimizer → Settings
    • Add your OpenAI API key for AI-powered features
    • Get your key from https://platform.openai.com/api-keys

  4. Start optimizing:

    • Edit any post or page
    • Look for the “Answer Engine Optimizer” meta box
    • Follow the real-time scoring and recommendations

System Requirements

  • WordPress 6.0 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
  • Gutenberg or Classic Editor support
  • OpenAI API key (optional, for AI features)
sections.faq:
What is Answer Engine Optimization (AEO)?

AEO is the practice of optimizing content to appear in AI-generated answers from platforms like Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity, and other AI search engines. It’s the next evolution of SEO for the AI era.

How is AEO different from SEO?

SEO focuses on ranking your content in traditional search results. AEO ensures your content is selected by AI systems to generate direct answers to user queries. Both are important for modern content visibility.

Do I need an OpenAI API key?

No, the plugin works without it. However, AI-powered features like summary suggestions require an OpenAI API key. You can still use all other features (scoring, schema, visibility checks) without it.

How much does the OpenAI API cost?

OpenAI charges per token used. Typical usage for summary generation costs a few cents per request. See https://openai.com/pricing for current rates.

Does this plugin work with Gutenberg?

Yes! The plugin works seamlessly with both Gutenberg block editor and Classic Editor. Real-time updates work in Gutenberg with automatic debouncing.

Will this slow down my website?

No. The plugin only loads admin assets in the WordPress dashboard. Frontend performance is unaffected. Real-time updates are optimized with debouncing and caching.

Can I use this with other SEO plugins?

Yes! Answer Engine Optimizer works alongside other SEO plugins like Yoast SEO, Rank Math, and All in One SEO. They complement each other.

How often does the AEO score update?

The score updates in real-time as you edit content in Gutenberg (with 1.5-second debounce). In Classic Editor, it updates on save. You can also manually refresh using the refresh button.

What post types are supported?

By default: Posts, Pages, and Services. You can extend support to custom post types via filters.

Can I export reports?

Yes! The dashboard includes a “Download Audit Report (PDF)” button for comprehensive content analysis.

How does the Content Insights update?

Content Insights (Words, FAQ Items, Summary Length) update in real-time as you edit, just like the AEO score.

Is there a REST API?

Yes! Full REST API support with endpoints for analysis, scoring, tips, and visibility checks. Perfect for custom integrations.

What about privacy and data?

All analysis happens on your server. Only OpenAI API calls (if configured) send content to external services. No data is stored externally.

How do I get support?

Visit the plugin support forum on WordPress.org or check the documentation at https://troontechnologies.com/aeo-docs

Can I contribute to development?

Yes! The plugin is open source. Visit our GitHub repository for contribution guidelines.

1.0.2

Bug Fix – Frontend DOM Injection

  • 🐛 Fixed: Removed unintended DOM injection of AEO summary that was appearing in frontend content
  • 🔧 Fixed: Summary now only appears in JSON-LD schema (head) for AI engines, not in visible DOM
  • ✅ Fixed: Resolved compatibility issues with page builders (Avada, Elementor, etc.)
  • 📝 Improved: Cleaned up unused frontend rendering methods

1.0.1

Initial Release – Complete AEO Solution

  • ✨ Real-Time AEO Scoring with Gutenberg integration
  • ✨ Unified AJAX endpoint for batch component updates
  • ✨ REST API with 4 endpoints for programmatic access
  • ✨ Real-time Content Insights updates (Words, FAQ Items, Summary Length)
  • ✨ AI-Powered Summary Suggestions via OpenAI
  • ✨ Automatic JSON-LD Schema Generation
  • ✨ Article, FAQ, and Service Schema Support
  • ✨ AI Crawler Visibility Checks
  • ✨ Content Structuring Guidance
  • ✨ Improvement Tips with Severity Levels
  • ✨ Dashboard with PDF Audit Report Export
  • ✨ Reporting page with filtering and sorting
  • ✨ Character counter with optimal range (300-500)
  • ✨ Auto-generated and manual summary support
  • ✨ Service metadata validation
  • ✨ Performance optimized with caching and debouncing
  • ✨ Classic Editor and Gutenberg support
  • ✨ Rate limiting and subscription-ready hooks
  • ✨ Comprehensive documentation and guides
